note: MOCK DATA for UI development. Every value is synthetic and must not be cited.
disclaimer: MOCK: Decision support, not a replacement for your agronomist.

strategies.name: Current corn-soybean (no cover)
strategies.why: MOCK: the reference. Shows what the field does now so every other option is compared to it.
strategies.satellite_evidence: MOCK: HLS shows the field bare from harvest to late May most years.

strategies.name: Cereal rye before soybean
strategies.short: Plant rye after corn harvest, end it before soybeans
strategies.why: MOCK: living roots take up nitrate in the bare months when storms hit.
strategies.satellite_evidence: MOCK: fields with rye green up 6 weeks earlier in HLS.

yield_risk.text: MOCK: little effect on soybean in most trials.

strategies.name: Extended rotation (corn-soy-oats/clover)
strategies.short: Add a small grain + clover year
strategies.why: MOCK: a third crop keeps roots in the soil for more months.
strategies.satellite_evidence: MOCK: extended-rotation fields stay green through fall in HLS.

yield_risk.text: MOCK: one year of lower-value crop; corn after clover yields more.

strategies.name: Split / in-season N
strategies.short: Apply nitrogen when the crop needs it
strategies.why: MOCK: less nitrate sits in the soil in spring.
strategies.satellite_evidence: MOCK: no direct satellite signal; uses field leak timing.

yield_risk.text: MOCK: similar yield if timed well.
